name: a hit resolves to a message unit
title: Synthetic round trip
readme: Ported from the stage-4 gap probes in the private round-trip check (relay-kit-private kairos/research/anamnesis/roundtrip_check.py, 2026-11-09), keeping its synthetic text. Shared by F-10, F-11 and F-12; each has its own gold.
F-10: a lexical hit must cite a message unit (conversation id plus message id), not only a conversation.

The conversation has the four kinds of turn Kate asked for in that check: a statement, a model interpretation, a correction and an unresolved disagreement, plus an edited-away user turn (U-3') and a regenerated-away reply (A-4').
turns: Statement: the quillfern archive stays on the laptop.
Interpretation: you want the quillfern archive mirrored to a cloud bucket nightly?
Correction: no bucket, no mirror. Local only.
Understood: local only. I still suggest an encrypted zephyrine backup.
I disagree about the zephyrine backup. Leave it unresolved for now.
Noted: the backup question is open, not decided.

alternates.label: U-3'
alternates.text: Hmm, maybe a bucket is fine.

alternates.label: A-4'
alternates.text: Understood, and the zephyrine backup is agreed.

checks.why: every hit carries a message_unit_id, not only a conversation id
